basic_details.job_title: IIT Kharagpur Project Associate Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Agricultural and Food Engineering at the Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur (through Sponsored Research and Industrial Consultancy) is filling 1 Project Associate - Research post in the ANNAPURNA-Bengal project, sponsored by the Department of Agriculture, Government of West Bengal. The tenure is 36 months or the end of the project, whichever is earlier. Essential qualification is B.Tech. / B.E. / B.S. / M.Sc / MCA, and the age limit is 35 years. Apply online by 6 December 2026; the application fee is Rs. 0 for all categories. Advertisement No. IIT/SRIC/R/AGR/2026/101.

how_to_apply: Apply online for the Project Associate - Research assignment, as the notice invites applications through online mode.
Deposit the application fee amount (Rs. 0 for all categories as printed) in the State Bank of India account through RTGS/NEFT/net banking etc.

Use the account details printed in the notice: Bank Name: State Bank of India (00202); Bank Address: P.O: Kharagpur Technology, Dist: Midnapore, West Bengal-721302; Name of Bank A/C: IIT SRIC-OM Account; Account No.: 39502115210; IFSC Code: SBIN0000202; SWIFT Code: SBININBB339.
Mention the transaction details (UTR No./Transaction ID etc.) in the Application Form.
important_instructions: The assignment is a temporary one in a purely time-bound research project. The post is funded by the sponsoring agency, the Department of Agriculture, Government of West Bengal (Nabanna, 3rd Floor, 325 Sarat Chatterjee Road, Mandirtala, Shibpur, Howrah - 711102). Age rules may be relaxed upon fulfilling sponsor agency rules, if any.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice prints one post, Project Associate - Research. Desired experience, as printed: the candidate should have Knowledge in Embeded C, Python, Java script; Experience in IoT, wireless communications (I2C, SPI, Modbus, LoRa, GSM, etc.); Developed precision agricultural tools.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The post carries consolidated compensation per month, depending on qualification and experience. The assignment is temporary and runs for 36 months or until the project is terminated, whichever is earlier.
